thread:
Maya: Quick idea — let's ship a 'Lightning Tutorial Kit' for OSS refapps. 
Ivan: +1, love a tiny, opinionated starter that shows routing + cost tips.
Sam T.: What should be in the kit? short checklist pls.
Maya: Minimal scope: 1) tiny Next.js refapp using Redwood API 2) one benchmark script (local) 3) 3 short tutorials (setup, perf tuning, embeds) 4) a single-page landing + CTA.
Lucy: Keep it <10min read per tutorial. We want low friction for devs.
Ivan: For bench: include quick curl + node script and a sample throughput graph. Call it "route-bench" and show cost delta from batching on/off.
Maya: Repo skeleton: github.com/redwood-inference/lightning-kit (placeholder). Sam, can you create repo and README template?
Sam T.: Yep. I'll scaffold today and add templates for tutorials and a tiny GH Actions deploy.
Nora: Messaging angle — "Get an app running in 10 minutes, optimize for cost in 30". Frontload value props: speed, cost, predictable latency.
Ivan: Suggest short benchmark narrative in README: "Out-of-the-box: 12 req/s, with batching + cache: 43 req/s, ~3x cost reduction" (we'll use real numbers later).
Maya: Marketing needs: launch post (600-800 words), 2 social quips, 1 webinar slot (30 min demo + Q&A), community thread template, and inbound routing rules.
Lucy: Webinar cadence: 20-min demo (Sam), 10-min Q&A (Ivan moderates). Target: Wed 2pm PT next week. Can ops get a calendar hold?
Sam T.: I'll do the demo script and a 5-slide one-pager. Demo will show drop-in integration, baseline bench, and tuning knobs.
Nora: Inbound routing: any signups from landing -> tag "lightning-kit" -> send to nurture drip (3 emails) -> if >3 demos started, route to sales SDR. We need the flow documented in HubSpot.
Maya: I'll draft the launch post. Nora, can you draft the email drip copy? Lucy, can you prep social snippets (X + LinkedIn)?
Lucy: On it. Two angles: dev-first quickstart + benchmark brag (one stat).
Ivan: Need to add a small eval harness with prompt set for quality smoke tests — avoid regressions when we suggest quantization.
Sam T.: Adding lightweight eval harness to repo. Also include a Dockerfile for local testing.
Maya: Deadline: repo + tutorial drafts by EOD +2 (two business days). Marketing assets + launch post by EOD +4. Webinar scheduled by EOD +3.
Nora: I'll set up HubSpot pipeline and the tagging rule; will share playbook link when done.
Ivan: One more ask — include an example config for Dedicated + Hosted fallbacks in the refapp (shows routing policy). That sells the unified runtime story.
Sam T.: Noted. Will add sample config and a small diagram in README.
Maya: Perfect — small, actionable, and repeatable. If everyone hits deadlines we can soft-launch to community Slack on Thurs. :tada:
launch-bot: Reminder set for 1992123520 - "Lightning Kit repo check-in".
Lucy: Quick Q — can we include a tiny GIF in the README showing the app response? It helps conversion.
Maya: Yes, add a 5s GIF (screen capture). Sam, link it to demo script.
Sam T.: Will produce GIF during demo prep.
Nora: I'll capture the signup -> tag -> nurture automation in a one-pager and share.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll open a short Loom for the draft brief and share it in #marketing. Any blockers?
Ivan: None. All good from DevRel side.
Maya: Closing — I'll ping when drafts are live. :rocket:
